decisions.title: House default: Townsville University Hospital facility 00200

proposal.text: The cohort is limited to Townsville University Hospital, facility code '00200'.
proposal.rationale: The RDL house default was confirmed by Data Engineer JoshKgh on 2026-09-29 (https://github.com/nq-rdl/agent-extensions/issues/436). Explicit other-facility, HHS or network-wide scope replaces it.

decisions.title: Date of death is the raw ieMR value, with no derived mortality flag

proposal.text: Date of death is the raw ieMR `PERSON.DECEASED_DT_TM`, shown as AEST. The extract derives no mortality flag.
proposal.rationale: The researcher applies any mortality window. A derived flag fixes a modelling choice that belongs to the researcher.

decisions.title: Mortality limitation: no death-registry linkage

proposal.text: Deaths outside hospital and long-term deaths undercount. There is no death-registry linkage, so a blank date of death does not mean that the patient is alive.
proposal.rationale: ieMR records only the deaths that the hospital knows about. It has no link to the death registry.

match: not mean that the patient is alive

decisions.title: ieMR clinical event dates: EVENT_END_DT_TM versus PERFORMED_DT_TM

proposal.text: For ieMR clinical events, `EVENT_END_DT_TM` is the clinically relevant time (collected or resulted). `PERFORMED_DT_TM` is the time that the event was performed or authored.
proposal.rationale: The two columns answer different questions. The extract names each date, so the analyst can choose.

decisions.title: Output time zone: ieMR UTC shown as AEST in the projection only

proposal.text: ieMR UTC times are shown as AEST with a fixed +10 hours, in the output projection only. Filters shift the anchor and keep the stored column bare.
proposal.rationale: Queensland has no daylight saving, so the fixed offset is correct today. A bare filter column keeps the index usable.

decisions.title: Output time zone limitation: the fixed +10 hours needs no daylight saving

proposal.text: The AEST output uses a fixed +10 hours from UTC. It is correct only while Queensland has no daylight saving.
proposal.rationale: The projection does not use a time zone database. A change to Queensland time rules would shift every output time.

proposal.text: A valid ieMR result has `RECORD_STATUS_CD` 188, `RESULT_STATUS_CD` 25, `VIEW_LEVEL > 0` and `VALID_UNTIL_DT_TM > GETUTCDATE()`.
proposal.rationale: The bundle removes deleted, unverified, hidden and superseded rows.

decisions.title: Result validity limitation: the currency test depends on the run time

proposal.text: Result validity uses `VALID_UNTIL_DT_TM > GETUTCDATE()`. A re-run on another day can return different result rows.
proposal.rationale: The currency test compares with the time of the run, not with a fixed date.

decisions.title: Date window: half-open, with ISO literals

proposal.text: Date windows are half-open: start <= date < end. The bounds are ISO `'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS'` literals.
proposal.rationale: A half-open window does not count a boundary instant twice. ISO literals do not depend on the language of the login.

decisions.title: Deliver raw dated events, not derived outcomes

proposal.text: The extract delivers raw dated events, not derived outcomes. The researcher applies any window.
proposal.rationale: An outcome window is a modelling choice. Raw dated rows let the researcher change a window without a new extract.

decisions.title: Demographics: current values, not as at the anchor

proposal.text: Demographics are the current values (the latest `mart_patient_view` row), not the values at the anchor date.
proposal.rationale: The source keeps the current row by default. Values at the anchor date need a history source and a separate decision.

decisions.title: Patient identity: the HBCIS URN is the raw episode MRN

proposal.text: The HBCIS URN is the raw episode MRN, with no merge-chain canonicalisation. A patient with merged MRNs can appear under more than one URN.
proposal.rationale: This is the query-builder default (ADR 0003). If the request needs merged identities, use `HBCISResolver(canonicalize_mrn=True)`, not a hand-written chain.
